templates.name: security_plan_starter
templates.description: Compact SSP narrative starter for system scope, selected control families, inheritance, and review ownership; use the implementation worksheet for control-by-control work.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST RMF and OSCAL SSP concepts. It is not an SSP schema.
compatibility.limitations: Working draft, not an official SSP, and not directly importable into another system.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and NIST OSCAL SSP model

templates.name: implementation_statement_worksheet
templates.description: Control-by-control drafting worksheet with ownership, evidence, inheritance, and eMASS API v3.22-aligned fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses MITRE eMASS API v3.22 control field names and values. Import into eMASS is not verified.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable; your eMASS instance may differ.

provenance.basis: MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 Controls schemas

templates.name: evidence_expectation_matrix
templates.description: Evidence planning matrix with cross-references, ownership, collection cadence, freshness, confidence, and assessor-facing notes.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST SP 800-53A assessment concepts and DISA cross-references. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Evidence expectations need assessor and organization validation.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 and ingested DISA cross-references

templates.name: stig_evidence_checklist
templates.description: STIG Viewer CSV columns from the V1R7 user guide plus a separate evidence working-notes sheet for assessment preparation.

compatibility.claim: Uses the 12 CSV headers and values in the DISA STIG Viewer 3.x User Guide V1R7. Import into STIG Viewer is not verified.
compatibility.limitations: Open the CSV in your STIG Viewer version to check it. Control Atlas has not tested an import.

provenance.basis: DISA STIG Viewer 3.x User Guide V1R7 CSV import contract

official_alternative.label: DISA STIG Viewer and SRG/STIG tools

templates.name: inheritance_worksheet
templates.description: Control inheritance decision log covering provider evidence, freshness, local responsibilities, deltas, and decision basis.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST RMF and OSCAL inheritance concepts. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Does not replace a provider CRM/CIS or approve an inheritance decision.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and OSCAL implemented-requirement inheritance concepts

official_alternative.label: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules and current provider documentation

templates.name: reciprocity_checklist
templates.description: Structured package-reuse review with artifact freshness, ownership, gaps, risk decisions, and receiving-organization actions.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST RMF authorization-package reuse concepts. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Does not grant reciprocity. The receiving Authorizing Official owns the reuse decision.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 authorization and ongoing-authorization concepts

templates.name: poam_starter
templates.description: Operational POA&M register with remediation, milestone, evidence, ownership, and eMASS API v3.22-aligned preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses MITRE eMASS API v3.22 POA&M field names and values. Import into eMASS is not verified.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable.

provenance.basis: MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 POA&M schemas; historical layout lessons from Vulnerator

templates.name: assessment_planning_worksheet
templates.description: Control assessment schedule covering scope, assessor, methods, evidence, tooling, sampling, dates, results, and follow-up.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST SP 800-53A assessment planning and eMASS test-result concepts. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Neither a complete Security Assessment Plan nor an eMASS test-result import file.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 and MITRE emass_client v3.22 Test Results schema

templates.name: conmon_calendar
templates.description: Monitoring schedule that connects activities to deliverables, evidence locations, owners, completion, reporting, and escalation.

compatibility.claim: Follows NIST continuous-monitoring concepts. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Seeded cadences are planning defaults unless the row names a source. Confirm them against your program's rules and contracts.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-137 and NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2

templates.name: hardware_baseline
templates.description: Asset inventory with operational ownership and eMASS API v3.22 hardware-baseline preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses MITRE eMASS API v3.22 hardware-baseline field names and values. Import into eMASS is not verified.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable.

provenance.basis: DCSA hardware list and MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 hardware schemas

templates.name: software_baseline
templates.description: Software inventory with lifecycle, approval, ownership, dependency, and eMASS API v3.22 preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses MITRE eMASS API v3.22 software-baseline field names. Import into eMASS is not verified.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable.

provenance.basis: DCSA software list and MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 software schemas

templates.name: ppsm_preparation_worksheet
templates.description: Local collection worksheet for ports, protocols, services, boundaries, mission need, exposure, and approval tracking before PPSM submission.

compatibility.claim: Collects the information the PPSM process asks for. It is not an interchange schema.
compatibility.limitations: Collect and review here, then enter the data in the authorized PPSM workflow. Not a PPSM submission form, registry receipt, or import file.

provenance.basis: DoDI 8551.01 and public DISA PPSM training
